get.description:
One page of the inventory; pass the returned `cursor` back until `complete` is true. A bound key lists only the sandboxes it sees.

Scope: `read`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page (default 50; more than 1000 counts as 1000).

200.description: `{items, cursor, complete}`; each item is a sandbox row.

400.description: An invalid body or query (`E_INVALID_PARAMS`) naming the first path.

401.description: A missing or invalid bearer token (`E_DENIED`).

403.description: The key lacks the scope, or a browser-originated request or foreign Host (`E_DENIED`).

429.description: Too many failed authentications from this address (`E_LIMIT`); see `Retry-After`.

default.description: Any other failure; see the error codes.

post.description:
Create a sandbox and wait until it is ready. The same `idempotencyKey` returns the sandbox it made before. `fromCheckpoint` restores a checkpoint. A bound key puts its labels on the new sandbox; a body label with another value is 403, and a key bound only by `sandboxIds` cannot create sandboxes.

Scope: `admin`.

400.description: An invalid body or query (`E_INVALID_PARAMS`) naming the first path.

401.description: A missing or invalid bearer token (`E_DENIED`).

403.description: The key lacks the scope, or a browser-originated request or foreign Host (`E_DENIED`).

429.description: Too many failed authentications from this address (`E_LIMIT`); see `Retry-After`.

default.description: Any other failure; see the error codes.
